# Fetch all pages for pending, approved, denied to get complete status of all requests
def fetch_all_requests(status):
    all_reqs = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, status=status, page_limit=20, page_index=page_index)
        if not page:
            break
        all_reqs.extend(page)
        if len(page) < 20:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return all_reqs

all_pending = fetch_all_requests('pending')

print("Approved count:", len(all_approved))

        status = 'approved'
